title: Vibrant Light Mediterranean Chinese Long Beans Skewers
description: A herbal and snappy Saudi-Arabian inspired dish featuring Chinese long beans, pressure-cooked to perfection with a Mediterranean twist.
instructions: Rinse the Chinese long beans and cut them into 1-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the Chinese long beans to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated Chinese long beans onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Pressure-cook the skewers for 5 minutes, or until the beans are tender but still crisp.
Remove the skewers from the pressure cooker and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
